module

public import Mathlib.Data.Sym.Sym2

public section

namespace Sym2
variable {α : Type*} {a : α}

@[simp] lemma fst_out_mk_self : (Quot.out s(a, a)).1 = a := by simpa using out_fst_mem s(a, a)
@[simp] lemma snd_out_mk_self : (Quot.out s(a, a)).2 = a := by simpa using out_snd_mem s(a, a)

end Sym2
